caption: mercury is retrograde in aquarius until mar 3 (20.9°). find your sign for the last stretch.

slides.headline: the last stretch of *mercury* retrograde. who it hits now
*mercury* backed out of pisces into aquarius
slides.body: it crossed back on feb 18 and seems to keep sliding until it turns direct at 20.9° aquarius on mar 3.

rows.label: aquarius
rows.text: it's in your sign now. reread yourself.

rows.label: leo
rows.text: a partner wants the talk you skipped.

rows.label: pisces
rows.text: it left your sign. the fog lifts.

rows.label: gemini
rows.text: a trip or course plan gets revised.

rows.label: libra
rows.text: an old crush likes your story.

rows.label: aries
rows.text: a friend comes back. let them.

rows.label: virgo
rows.text: tweak one routine, not all of them.

rows.label: capricorn
rows.text: venus is with you. use it.

slides.headline: the reply can wait a day. the *truth* can't.
